lines.zh: 金发竖着，我一步一步走近。
lines.en: Golden hair on end, I close in step by step.

lines.zh: 电流在发梢上跳，走起来很响。
lines.en: Sparks dance at my hair tips and crackle as I walk.
I walk the air and flatten the grass under it.
In this form even walking costs effort.

lines.zh: 我绕着对手走，让他跟着转。
lines.en: I circle and make him turn with me.

lines.zh: 金色气焰在我身后拖着。
lines.en: A golden aura trails behind me.

lines.zh: 金发绷直，我踩着碎石走。
lines.en: Golden hair stiff, I walk over the gravel.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，地面凹下去。
lines.en: The ground dips when I land.
I take my time and let him see me clearly.
Steam rises from my bootprints.

lines.zh: 我滑行半格，再猛地停住。
lines.en: I glide half a block, then stop dead.

lines.zh: 我转身，头发跟着飘起来。
lines.en: I turn and my hair lifts with the motion.

lines.zh: 我站着，气把石块抬了起来。
lines.en: I stand and my aura lifts the loose stones.

lines.zh: 这个形态的电流在耳边响。
lines.en: In this form lightning buzzes at my ear.
I clench my fist, then release it.

lines.zh: 气焰把我的披风吹起来。
lines.en: My aura whips the cape upward.

lines.zh: 我盯着他，眼睛是青色的。
lines.en: I watch him with these pale eyes.
The power is still climbing.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，示意他过来。
lines.en: I lift my chin. Come on, then.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石在轻轻发抖。
lines.en: The gravel under me trembles.
I bank my ki, then let it out again.

lines.zh: 这形态撑不了太久，我知道。
lines.en: This form will not last long. I know.

lines.zh: 远处有雷声，和我的气很配。
lines.en: Thunder far off suits my aura.
I look at the weapon in his hands.
I hold one breath in.
My shadow is bright on the ground.

lines.zh: 你看清楚了，这是第二个阶段。
lines.en: Look closely. This is the second stage.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我压不了多久。
lines.en: I cannot hold this form for long.
You still have the nerve to stand.

lines.zh: 光看我的头发，你就该退了。
lines.en: The hair alone should send you back.

lines.zh: 你的气还不够我一只手。
lines.en: Your ki is not enough for one of my hands.
Lightning crawls on me. Do not touch.
You are not here to beg, are you?

lines.zh: 我认得这个眼神，是拼命的眼神。
lines.en: I know that look. It is the look of desperation.
I can wait. You may not be able to.

lines.zh: 你身边还有几个？一起上。
lines.en: How many are with you? All at once.

lines.zh: 我的气把空气压出响声。
lines.en: My aura makes the air crackle.
Do not measure me with your common sense.

lines.zh: 你知道自己打不赢，还站着。
lines.en: You know you cannot win and still you stand.

lines.zh: 我手指一动，你该后退了。
lines.en: When my fingers move, you should step back.

lines.zh: 这一战，我只想快点结束。
lines.en: I want this over quickly.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，听得见吗。
lines.en: Your breathing is ragged. Hear it?

lines.zh: 我给你最后一次退后的机会。
lines.en: I give you one last chance to step back.
When I move, you will not see it.
This form feels pain too. Do not mistake it.

lines.zh: 我挡住大半，还是退了一步。
lines.en: I caught most of it and still stepped back.

lines.zh: 电流护着我，只是不完全。
lines.en: The current shielded me, not completely.
My blood hits the ground and smokes.
I breathe in and the aura grows again.

lines.zh: 这点伤，在这个形态里很快就补上。
lines.en: In this form such wounds close quickly.
I press my fingers to the wound.
The Final Flash needs no prep.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我没护住的地方。
lines.en: You hit a place I left open.
I lift my eyes to him with no expression.
Eat now? Poor timing.
That smell has disturbed my ki.
After the fight.
One bite and my aura will break.

lines.zh: 拿开，这形态不需要食物。
lines.en: Take it away. This form needs no food.
My stomach growls. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 这味道让我分了半秒神。
lines.en: That smell cost me half a second.

lines.zh: 你拿食物乱我心神，聪明。
lines.en: Using food to distract me. Clever.
When this is over I will find you.

lines.zh: 别在我面前晃，我会分心。
lines.en: Do not wave it about. I lose focus.
You hit my aura. Your hand will hurt.
That bump is dust.
Back off. The current does not look where it goes.
I lift a foot and the ground splits.
My aura pushed you away.
Keep your hands off the current on my arm.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的气就涨一寸。
lines.en: A bump and my aura rises an inch.
You cannot even keep your feet.
Move. I have no time to go around.
That knocked you three steps back.

lines.zh: 这副样子，不想让她看见。
lines.en: I do not want her to see me like this.

lines.zh: 金色头发，不是给谁看的。
lines.en: The golden hair is not for anyone's eyes.
This ki is too strong. Standing close would hurt.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的骄傲，不轻言退。
lines.en: A Saiyan's pride doesn't retreat lightly.

lines.zh: 这形态下，我连话都懒得说。
lines.en: In this form I cannot even be bothered to talk.
When I change back, then we speak.
I remember the lamp at home.
I do not say soft things. Never have.

lines.zh: 她骂我的时候，我不生气。
lines.en: When she scolds me, I do not get angry.

lines.zh: 这些心事，装在气里就够了。
lines.en: These feelings are enough carried in ki.

lines.zh: 我捏起一块石头，碎成粉。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and it crumbles.
This weight barely registers.
I lift it and weigh it in my palm.

lines.zh: 地上的东西被我的气吸起来了。
lines.en: My aura pulls the loose things up.

lines.zh: 我不用弯腰，气会替我拿。
lines.en: I need not bend. My ki brings it to me.
A piece of iron bends in my grip.

lines.zh: 掉落物归我，这没什么好争。
lines.en: The drop is mine. Nothing to argue.
I look at it and toss it back down.
My palm runs hot and scorches what it holds.
This little orb, I keep.
His ki just shifted.

lines.zh: 两步而已，我一口气就够。
lines.en: Two steps, no more; one breath gets me there.
I have read his stance.
He moved first. Then I answer.
My ki has locked onto him.
He retreats slower than before.
A spark jumps between my fingers.
I raise my hand. This one.

lines.zh: 他挡住我第一招，值得夸。
lines.en: He blocked my first strike. Worth a nod.
From here he has nowhere to go.
His opening is at the shoulder.
I do not wait for him to be ready.
The ki in my chest surges once.
He runs. He cannot outrun me.
A prince's pride, low stance.
I am already moving into that step.
I am waiting for his strength to give out.

lines.zh: 他一直退，没注意到身后。
lines.en: He keeps backing and does not check behind.
I read that one twice over.
The sparks cover what I am doing.
This circling has run long.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸一次比一次深。
lines.en: Each breath he takes goes deeper.

lines.zh: 我贴地滑近，气在后面拖。
lines.en: I skim in low with my aura trailing.

lines.zh: 他举着武器，手已经在抖。
lines.en: He holds the weapon up and his hands shake.

lines.zh: 我等他做那个多余的动作。
lines.en: I wait for that one wasted motion.
He has shifted onto his front foot.

lines.zh: 残影拳的路线，我已经想好。
lines.en: I have the Afterimage route worked out.

lines.zh: 他一直看我头发，不看我的手。
lines.en: He watches my hair, not my hands.
This strike comes from above.
He backs to the rock wall. No road.

lines.zh: 我再近半格，就进入范围。
lines.en: Half a block more and he is in range.
He raises a guard. Exactly what I wanted.
The ki still climbs. I am in no hurry.
His eyes slid away.
One flash and I am behind him.
A meteor string of punches comes down.

lines.zh: 加利克炮从我掌心冲出。
lines.en: The Galick Gun erupts from my palm.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的衣领往上抛。
lines.en: I seize his collar and throw him upward.
Lightning wraps my fist as it lands.

lines.zh: 这一脚把他踹穿一堵墙。
lines.en: This kick sends him through a wall.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击在他脚下开。
lines.en: Big Bang Attack opens at his feet.
I chase him up and drive him down.
He guards the fist; his ribs are bare.

lines.zh: 终极闪光从我手中射出。
lines.en: Final Flash fires from my hands.

lines.zh: 我按住他的头往地里压。
lines.en: I press his head toward the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一下的力道，你受不住。
lines.en: You cannot take the force of this one.

lines.zh: 流星连拳，你只接住第一下。
lines.en: Meteor rush: you block only the first blow.
My elbow strikes under his throat.

lines.zh: 他还没站稳，我已经到了。
lines.en: He was not set and I was already there.
He is on the ground, still alive.
Golden aura rises off the ground.

lines.zh: 电流在我周围织成一片。
lines.en: Lightning weaves a field around me.

lines.zh: 岩石被我的气压得下沉。
lines.en: The rock sinks under my presence.
I have taken this form.

lines.zh: 头发竖起来了，气也满了。
lines.en: My hair stands up and the ki is full.

lines.zh: 落地太重，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: Landed too hard; the ground gave way.
The wind here has stopped.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛已经变了色。
lines.en: I look up and my eyes have changed color.
Light spreads out from my feet.
I drop from the sky and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 周围的东西都开始浮起来。
lines.en: Everything around me begins to float.

lines.zh: 金色气焰把云都顶开了。
lines.en: My golden aura pushes the clouds apart.
I will not stay in this form long.
I set my feet and clench my fists.

lines.zh: 两个阶段，现在到第二个。
lines.en: Two stages. This is the second.
Even the thunder arrives with me.
I plant my foot and shale scatters.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，气焰更亮。
lines.en: I exhale and the aura burns brighter.

lines.zh: 火焰被我的气顶开，还是烫。
lines.en: My aura holds the flame off, but it burns.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，砸穿石板。
lines.en: I fall from high and smash through stone.
Water reaches my throat and the ki cuts out.

lines.zh: 那团爆炸把气焰都撕开。
lines.en: The blast even tore my aura apart.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸撞上了我的侧肋。
lines.en: A shot struck my side.

lines.zh: 这股力量缠住我的气脉。
lines.en: This force binds my ki channels.

lines.zh: 这个形态耗得太凶，我撑不住。
lines.en: This form burns too much. I am failing.

lines.zh: 天上落雷，和我身上的电撞了。
lines.en: Sky lightning struck and clashed with mine.

lines.zh: 我被拖走，连气也留不住。
lines.en: I am dragged off and even my ki will not stay.
